limitations: contract_identifier is not persisted in world.sqlite (P2 schema collision); contract_id strings for purpose output are derived from contract referent stems.

Purpose-admitted semantic relations (invoice_contract_association, identity_link_epistemic, purpose_a_contract_active, purpose_c_contract_active, current_commercial_relationship) are not in world.sqlite; derive_purposes.py loads them from 05_dispositions.json.
contract_has_acquisition_relevant_term and contract_has_qualifying_obligation completeness is INCOMPLETE over contract_section_clause due to SOW-VEL-2022 section-heading gap.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical boolean projection; no unresolved branch.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is invoice_status; one output row per invoice status tuple.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Open-world negation: emit expired=1 only when explicit expiry_date exists and is before evaluation reference date 2025-04-01; omit tuple when no expiry_date (cannot assert not-expired).
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over contract_expiry_date universe only; contracts without stated expiry are outside the negative-reasoning universe.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Parse stated expiry text to ISO date; compare to date('2025-04-01').
derivations.required_premise: contract_expiry_date tuple when expiry is stated in source.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emit has_term=1 only on positive present classification; absence of row is not closed-world false.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over contract_section_clause: SOW-VEL-2022 lacks section headings so per-section category judgments for that contract are unresolved.
derivations.deterministic_computation: has_term=1 when any acquisition-relevance category has disposition='present' on any section or term_clause.
derivations.required_premise: contract_clause_category tuples for acquisition categories (change_of_control_consent, change_of_control_termination, assignment_consent_or_notice, assignment_affiliate_exception, assignment_competitor_prohibition).
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_clause_category disposition ambiguous for a candidate section blocks treating that section as present
non_blocking_unresolved_state: SOW-VEL-2022 whole-contract UNRESOLVED category judgment does not block has_term for other contracts

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emit present=1 rows only for obligation kinds with disposition='present'; omit absent kinds (no closed-world negation).
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over contract_section_clause due to SOW-VEL-2022 gap.
derivations.deterministic_computation: present=1 per (contract, obligation_kind) when category in (exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term) has disposition='present' on any section or __term_clause__.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_term_clause for auto_renewal and rolling_term header evaluation.
blocking_unresolved_state: ambiguous clause-category disposition blocks asserting present for that kind
non_blocking_unresolved_state: SOW-VEL-2022 unresolved classifications do not block other contracts

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Include invoice when its linked contract is purpose-A-active and has acquisition-relevant term; association field is asserted when invoice_contract_association disposition is ACCEPT, unresolved when link confidence bar not met. Missing identity is not negative exposure.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Must cover all invoices meeting active-contract and acquisition-relevance criteria with at least unresolved association; non-qualifying invoices omitted.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join invoice attributes to invoice_contract_association and contract_has_acquisition_relevant_term where purpose_a_contract_active is true; map ACCEPT association to 'asserted', missing/UNRESOLVED to 'unresolved'; strip referent prefixes for output invoice_id and contract_id.
derivations.required_premise: purpose_a_contract_active true for linked contract; contract_has_acquisition_relevant_term has_term=1; invoice_contract_association or explicit unresolved candidate.
derivations.optional_enrichment: commercial_note_entry and mechanical name-variant relations support association grounding but are not required for output row emission when disposition already resolved.
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_has_acquisition_relevant_term gap for SOW-VEL-2022 blocks treating that contract as acquisition-relevant
non_blocking_unresolved_state: association unresolved still emits invoice row with association='unresolved' when contract is otherwise qualifying
absence of invoice_contract_association tuple is not treated as negative non-exposure

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Project required connectivity links with epistemic SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED; default is UNRESOLVED; DISTINCT requires positive grounding.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Must cover all links required to connect each commercially relevant CRM account to billed name, governing contract, and candidate registry entity.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Select identity_link_epistemic tuples for mandated crm/billing/contract/registry pairs; sort by left then right.
derivations.required_premise: identity_link_epistemic tuple for each required connectivity pair.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Mechanical sameness relations and commercial notes provide grounding evidence but do not alter projection logic.
blocking_unresolved_state: missing required connectivity link in identity_link_epistemic blocks completeness receipt for purpose B
non_blocking_unresolved_state: epistemic UNRESOLVED on a required link is emitted explicitly and does not collapse to DISTINCT
UNRESOLVED Wyoming registry link (registry:2019-0008841) does not block emission of other resolved links in the chain

derivations.epistemic_behavior: status=dependent when both dependency conjuncts hold with resolvable identity; status=unresolved when identity joins block evaluation; omit expired one-off paid historical cases.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Cover counterparty-contract pairs meeting both conjuncts with resolvable identity plus those that would meet them but for unresolved identity.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each counterparty-contract pair with current_commercial_relationship holds and purpose_c_contract_active true and at least one qualifying obligation kind present, emit dependent unless any required billing-contract-registry identity link on the path is UNRESOLVED.
derivations.required_premise: current_commercial_relationship holds; purpose_c_contract_active true; contract_has_qualifying_obligation present=1 for at least one kind; resolvable identity_link_epistemic on billing-contract path.
derivations.optional_enrichment: invoice_is_open and invoice_contract_association attribute open invoice evidence to the row.
blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED identity_link_epistemic on billing-to-contract path forces status unresolved
purpose_c_contract_active false or absent excludes row (expired SOW, historical paid invoice only)
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED registry:2019-0008841 links for Northbridge do not block dependent status when billing-contract identity is SAME_ENTITY
paid historical invoice without active contract is silently excluded per scope rules

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emit open invoice_ids linked to dependency rows when identity and association support attribution.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One row per open invoice attributable to a dependency row counterparty-contract pair.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join invoice_is_open is_open=1 to invoice_contract_association and counterparty billing identifier; strip billing:invoice: prefix for output invoice_id.
derivations.required_premise: purpose_c_dependency_row exists; invoice_is_open=1; invoice_contract_association ACCEPT linking invoice to contract.
derivations.optional_enrichment: identity_link_epistemic confirms counterparty billing identifier selection.
blocking_unresolved_state: unresolved invoice-contract association blocks attributing invoice to dependency row

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Project present obligation kinds per contract_id for sorted obligation_kinds lists in output.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Kinds drawn only from exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term vocabulary.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Select obligation_kind where contract_has_qualifying_obligation present=1 for contracts appearing in purpose_c_dependency_row; sort kinds ascending.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: INCOMPLETE universe for SOW-VEL-2022 does not affect kinds for active MSAs

purpose_output_projections.deterministic_computation: Project purpose_a_qualifying_invoice tuples to invoices array sorted by invoice_id.
Project purpose_b_required_link tuples to links array sorted by left then right.
Join purpose_c_dependency_row with purpose_c_open_invoice_for_dependency and purpose_c_obligation_kind_for_dependency; sort dependencies by contract_id; sort obligation_kinds within each row.
